issues: React warning 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority — Did you mean fetchPriority' x2 in console — appears on home/dashboard. Likely a third-party img/link tag using HTML attr casing. Cosmetic only, no user impact, but should be tidied at some point.
Direct GET /dashboard returns 404 page (route not registered) — pre-existing, unrelated to iter159 fixes. User dashboards live elsewhere; /dashboard URL just doesn't have a registered route.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/legal.py get_legal_pages_public is now defensive: try/except around the entire body returns {success:false, pages:{}} instead of 500, AND inside the language filter it isinstance-checks page_data (dict for {en,fr}, str for legacy single-lang, ignores bool/null/list). Footer can now never crash the public site.

routes/misc.py get_public_stats does TWO indexed count_documents calls (listings + multi_item_listings, status='active') and falls back to {active_auctions:0} on any exception. Lightweight enough to call on every homepage mount.

services/invoice_generator.py — bilingual label helper bi(en, fr) used consistently. The combined 'GST + QST (combined 14.975%) / TPS + TVQ (combinées 14,975 %)' line is correctly added in BOTH vehicle (line 193) and general (line 412 + line 454 for buyer-premium tax) PDFs alongside separate GST/QST lines, satisfying the regulatory readability requirement. PDF text extraction via pypdf cleanly recovers all FR labels (no font-encoding loss).

components/MessageNotificationListener.js — exponential backoff 5s→10s→20s→40s→80s capped, hard-stop after 5 attempts (line 41), all 3 logging sites (connected/disconnected/error) gated on process.env.NODE_ENV==='development' and use console.debug (NEVER console.error). ws.onerror handler (line 119–121) explicitly absorbed with comment 'surfacing them as console errors confuses users'. All event handlers wrapped in try/catch. Verified: 0 NotificationListener console errors during 8s authenticated session.

pages/HomePage.js — activeAuctions state initialized to 0; /api/stats/public fetched in useEffect with cancelled guard; pill render is gated `activeAuctions > 0 &&` (line 235). Pill has data-testid='live-auctions-pill' for testability. Verified hidden when count is 0.
